name: Code Health Auditor
title_zh: 定位 TS/JS 仓库死代码与可合并模块的审计器
tagline_zh: Code review 时、清理 PR 前，它用 Knip 交叉真实测试覆盖率，按范围粒度指出死代码和可合并项——。
tagline_en: Before cleanup PRs or during review, it cross-references Knip with real test coverage at range granularity to.
desc_en: Finds dead code and consolidation candidates in a TypeScript/JavaScript monorepo using Knip cross-referenced against real test coverage at range granularity — never auto-deletes, never claims confidence it doesn't have. Use during code review, before a cleanup PR, or on a periodic dogfooding run.
why_zh: 用测试覆盖率给 Knip 结果做二次过滤，只报真正没被触达的代码；范围粒度让结论可复核，不把仓库当黑盒。
why_en: Filters Knip findings through actual test coverage, reporting only truly unreachable code at range granularity—auditable, not a.
limit_zh: 只认 TypeScript/JavaScript 单仓（monorepo）；需要已有 Knip 配置和测试运行器。
limit_en: TS/JS monorepo only; requires existing Knip config and test runner; outputs audit report, not patches; below 60% coverage, false positives drown.
